methodological_rigor.justification: The manuscript consists only of a title and lacks any description of the study design, experimental procedures, or statistical methods. Without these sections, it is impossible to evaluate the methodological rigor or the appropriateness of the statistical analysis, and no conclusions can be supported.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: This study utilizes a rat model to investigate the role of MSK1 in subarachnoid hemorrhage, which classifies it as Level 5 evidence. While subarachnoid hemorrhage is a critical clinical condition, the findings are limited to mechanistic observations of protein downregulation and apoptosis in animals. The translational path to human clinical application remains speculative, and the study does not demonstrate direct relevance to current clinical guidelines or practice.

reporting_quality.justification: The manuscript provided consists solely of a title indicating a retraction and lacks any body text, methods, or results, failing all criteria of the ARRIVE guidelines. No information regarding data or code availability is present, rendering the work entirely irreproducible in its current form.

novelty_literature.justification: The manuscript presents an incremental extension of established mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) signaling research by applying it to a rat model of subarachnoid hemorrhage. While it identifies MSK1 as a participant in neuronal and astrocytic apoptosis, the conceptual framework and experimental methods are standard, and MSK1's neuroprotective role has been previously characterized in other CNS injury and ischemia models.

writing_presentation.justification: The manuscript is fundamentally incomplete, providing only a title and lacking an abstract, introduction, methods, results, and discussion. This total absence of content precludes any evaluation of writing quality, organization, or scientific communication.

key_strengths: The title identifies a specific molecular target (MSK1) in a relevant pathology (SAH).
key_concerns: The manuscript is explicitly labeled as retracted.

chief_reviewer.rationale: The manuscript is a retracted title with no body text, making it impossible to conduct a valid scientific review. Furthermore, several sub-agents hallucinated study details based solely on the title.
